items.passageEn: Last week, my father's leather wallet was missing. He looked everywhere. "This is awful," he said. My mother told him to think differently: "Where did you go yesterday?" He remembered the precise time he left the cafe: three o'clock. The principal problem was that he had no money for the bus. Then the cafe called. They had his wallet! "That's brilliant!" he said and laughed.
items.passageZh: 上週，我爸爸的皮夾不見了。他到處找。他說：「真是糟透了。」媽媽要他換個方式想：「你昨天去了哪裡？」他想起自己離開咖啡店的確切時間：三點。最主要的問題是他沒錢搭公車。接著咖啡店打電話來，說他們撿到了他的皮夾！他笑著說：「太好了！」

items.promptZh: 我和我哥哥穿衣服的方式很不一樣。
referenceEn: My brother and I dress very differently.
My brother and I dress differently.
rubricZh: 用 differently 表示「不同地」，放在動詞後（例如 dress differently）
「穿衣服的方式」可寫，例如 dress differently、wear clothes differently 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：principal 在初中級最常用的是名詞「校長」，本課用形容詞「主要的」（the principal reason／the principal problem，偏正式、較高級用法）；請依 CEFR-J 該級詞性確認，若 A2 為名詞應改例句與釋義。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：教課綱該級列的詞性。principal 在 lexicon 是形容詞 A2、名詞 B2，維持形容詞「主要的」
